names.summary: A 239-byte housekeeping beacon with a wall-clock timer near offset 156, several rolling counters, and a block of sun-dependent power fields at offsets 45-84. The block holds battery or thermal-like bytes, solar-input channels, and a few weak sun-correlated sensors. Many fields are heavily quantized, so the engine's guesses are only moderately reliable.

fields.name: battery_voltage_a
fields.rationale: Smooth u1 that rises in sun (+0.26) and falls in shadow (-0.61), with a ratio of 0.90 and tau of 40 min. It moves with offsets 46 and 47, so it could also be a panel or battery temperature. The unit and scale are a guess. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: battery_voltage_b
fields.rationale: Nearly identical to offset 45: same trends, same range, shadow/sun ratio 0.90. It forms a group with 45 and 47. The scale is unknown. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: battery_voltage_c
fields.rationale: Same behaviour as 45 and 46 with a narrower swing (ratio 0.95). It rises in sun and falls in shadow. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: adc_channel_49
fields.rationale: Only 9 distinct values around -125 with a tiny sun difference (0.24 std), so it is probably noise or a quantised ADC channel. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_58
fields.rationale: Mostly constant at 28-29 with rare outliers. This looks like an idle ADC channel. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_panel_current_a
fields.rationale: Plateau of about 134 in sun and about 11 in shadow with no trend in sun, as expected for a solar input. It moves with 62. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_aux_61
fields.rationale: Small signed values that step with sunlight (-1 in shadow, 0 to 1 in sun), but only 4 distinct values. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_current_2
fields.rationale: Drops to about 8 in shadow and reaches 100-135 in sun, with no trend. It moves with offset 60 and carries a solar hint. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_array_input_c
fields.rationale: u2le that is about 5-7k in shadow and about 35k in sun, so it is solar-like with a ratio of 0.17. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: battery_current
fields.rationale: Signed big-endian value, saturating at -255 in shadow and up to 1671 in sun with a sign flip, which fits a charge and discharge current. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: adc_channel_68
fields.rationale: Weak sun dependence with a baseline of about 6.5-7k and a low sun difference (0.08 std). [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: battery_voltage_or_soc
fields.rationale: Strongest lag correlation (0.92), rising in sun and falling in shadow, and moving with 64. It is likely a charge-related quantity, but the 94-255 range could also be a temperature. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_72
fields.rationale: Mostly constant at 28-29 with outliers, like offset 58. Idle channel. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: solar_array_input_d
fields.rationale: Big-endian u2 that is about 511 in shadow and about 34000 in sun, which is solar-like. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: battery_soc_or_temp
fields.rationale: Integrating sun response with positive trend in sun and negative trend in shadow, ratio 0.73, range 91-255. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_79
fields.rationale: Constant at 28-29 with rare outliers. Idle channel. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_83
fields.rationale: Constant at 28-29 with outliers and a weak inverse sun correlation. Idle channel. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_84
fields.rationale: Signed u2 that falls in shadow, but the sun trend is also negative and the pattern is inconsistent. [2/3 samples agree]

fields.name: counter_89
fields.rationale: u2 that increases about 0.5 per second and wraps, with 13 resets in the window. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: counter_97
fields.rationale: u2 that increases about 1.1 per second and wraps, with 15 resets. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: counter_99
fields.rationale: u4be counter that is mostly increasing, with one reset 33.5 days before the end. It moves with 136 and 153. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: counter_106
fields.rationale: u3be counter with 3 resets and the last one 5.5 days before the end. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: counter_136
fields.rationale: u4be counter starting at 2^31 that moves with 99, with the same reset 33.5 days before the end. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: counter_141
fields.rationale: u2 that increases at about 2.3 per second, with 21 wraps and the last one at the end of the window. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: counter_146
fields.rationale: u1 rolling counter with 21 wraps. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: counter_153
fields.rationale: u2be counter with 4 resets, the last one 11 days before the end. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: uptime_clock
fields.rationale: u3be increments at 1.0 s per second with no resets, so it is a seconds timer. The epoch is custom. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: sensor_171
fields.rationale: Orbit-phase dependent (r2 0.30), with a large range and a falling trend in both sun and shadow. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: battery_current_small
fields.rationale: Signed small value that is positive in shadow and negative in sun, with its sign flipping and a tau of 20 min. It could be a battery current or a trickle-charge reading. [1/3 samples agree]

fields.name: regulated_value_229
fields.rationale: Four values between 250 and 253 and sun-correlated. Too coarse to classify. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: magnetometer_or_gyro_x
fields.rationale: Signed, noisy, and weakly anti-correlated with sunlight. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: u2_orbit_232
fields.rationale: Weak orbit relation (r2 0.25) and a rough signal. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: signed_sensor_234
fields.rationale: Small signed noisy value, weakly lower in sun. [3/3 samples agree]

fields.name: orbit_signed_sensor_235
fields.rationale: Signed value that follows the orbital phase (r2 0.64), possibly a field-component or attitude-rate channel, but it is not identified. [3/3 samples agree]

names.health: Several counters show frequent resets: 21 on offsets 141 and 146, plus 13 and 15 on 89 and 97. These are probably rolling counters rather than reboots. The 156 clock has no resets, which argues against recent reboots. The battery-like fields (45-47) rise in sun and fall in shadow with stable ranges, but their daily lows and highs are drifting. That may indicate seasonal variation or early ageing, and there is not enough evidence to say which.
